inserts.afterExact: HDB flats (Housing Development Board—Singapore's public housing) are your best value: SGD1,000–1,500/month for a shared room. Private condominiums cost SGD1,800–3,000. For your first month, use HeyStay, Airbnb, PropertyGuru while apartment hunting. Once hired, contact your company's HR for corporate housing programs—many large employers have partner blocks with discounts.

If job-hunting while based in Malaysia, stay at Pelangi Capsule in Johor Bahru—just 20 minutes from the Causeway—at RM50–80 per night. You can interview in Singapore daily while keeping accommodation costs low.

officialSection:
Official Information

Figures below were checked against Singapore's Ministry of Manpower (MOM) pages on 1 October 2026. Rules change, so confirm on MOM before you apply.

  • Employment Pass salary: MOM lists the minimum qualifying salary as $5,600 a month for general sectors ($6,200 for financial services), rising with age from 23. From 1 January 2027 it becomes $6,000 ($6,600 for financial services). MOM: EP eligibility
  • COMPASS: EP applicants must earn 40 points on COMPASS, unless they earn a fixed monthly salary of at least $22,500 or fall under another listed exemption. MOM: EP eligibility
  • EP validity: first-time candidates up to 2 years, renewals up to 3 years. MOM: EP key facts
  • S Pass salary and validity: new candidates need at least $3,300 a month (rising with age; $3,600 from 1 January 2027). First-time passes run up to 2 years, renewals up to 3, and employers are subject to a quota and levy. MOM: S Pass eligibility / MOM: S Pass key facts
  • Work Permit: for semi-skilled workers from approved source countries or regions in the construction, manufacturing, marine shipyard, process or services sectors. Valid up to 2 years; family passes are not available. MOM: Work Permit key facts
  • Bringing family on an EP: spouse and children need the EP holder to earn at least $6,000 a month; parents need at least $12,000. MOM: EP passes for family

discrepancies.existing: Employment Pass (EP) is for professionals and managers earning SGD5,000+ monthly with recognised qualifications.
discrepancies.official: MOM: minimum qualifying salary is $5,600 a month (general sectors), $6,200 for financial services; $6,000 / $6,600 from 1 Jan 2027.
discrepancies.suggestedReplacement: Employment Pass (EP) is for professionals and managers earning at least SGD5,600 monthly (SGD6,000 from 1 January 2027); the minimum rises with age and is higher in financial services.

discrepancies.existing: S Pass targets skilled workers earning SGD3,150–4,999 with technical expertise or credentials or certifications.
discrepancies.official: MOM: new S Pass candidates need at least $3,300 a month ($3,600 from 1 Jan 2027). Declaring qualifications is optional. Upper bound 4,999 is not an MOM figure (EP minimum is 5,600).
discrepancies.suggestedReplacement: S Pass targets skilled workers earning at least SGD3,300 monthly (SGD3,600 from 1 January 2027) who may not meet EP criteria, subject to a quota.

discrepancies.official: UNVERIFIED: the MOM pages fetched (EP/S Pass eligibility, key facts) do not state processing times. Not a proven error; consider softening to 'processing time varies'.
discrepancies.suggestedReplacement: Processing time varies by case; ask your employer or check MOM.
